decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a double garage   
to a new location at the rear of the existing dwellinghouse, because of 
its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due 
regard for the site characteristics of number 287 Jersey Road and is 
complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be 
detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties.    The development is in                     accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New  Development)  and ENVB 2.2              (Conservation     Areas),   T 4.4  (Road Safety) and T 1. 4   (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) of the London   Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

10.1	Conditions
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the garage is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southeast wall of the garage hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of double garage to new location to rear garden of existing dwellinghouse.
